description: Draw a reaction scheme from its parts: reactants joined by plus signs, an arrow with optional text above and below, then products. Each structure is SMILES, InChI or a molfile. For a reaction already written as reaction SMILES, use draw. Refused, with the reason, instead of drawn wrongly: SMILES that cannot be read, aromatic rings that cannot alternate single and double bonds, and atoms with too many bonds (unless `as_written`). The result carries `drawing` (Lone Pair JSON to pass to edit_drawing or back in as `input`) and `notes` (anything changed on reading or lost in the format).

above.description: Text above the arrow: reagents or catalyst. Digits after letters become subscripts (H2SO4).

as_written.description: Draw atoms that have too many bonds instead of refusing the structure. Default false.

below.description: Text below the arrow: solvent, temperature, time.

dpi.description: PNG resolution, 300 by default; 600 for print.

format.description: png (default; returned as an image), svg (returned as text), pdf or eps (returned as base64 in `data_base64`).

opaque.description: White background instead of transparent (SVG, PNG). Default false.

style.description: Journal style. acs = ACS Document 1996 (default), rsc = RSC, nature = Nature Reviews, slides = heavier lines for slides.

name: render_reaction
title: Draw a reaction scheme
